_doc: aigen manifest (tools/aigen/aigen.py, docs/adr/0007); fields as in brazier.json. The wall torch: the original draws it as two crossed wall textures with the flame painted on (grd08886 'Torch Attaches to wall', side view with its bracket; grd08887 the front view). Made from the side view with the flame erased ("texture", "erase_flame"); the world build stands it on the wall where tools/environment/fires.py finds each torch, and the flame stays the original's flipbook (props.json fires "torch" "mesh"). Symmetrical: the side view mirrored is the view from the other side.
name: walltorch
describe: a medieval wall torch seen from the side, unlit, no flame: a short round dark wooden handle standing upright, its top a charred black head, held near its middle by a wide grey wrought-iron collar band; from the collar an iron bracket reaches left to the wall: a straight horizontal arm and a diagonal brace below it meeting at a small upright iron plate at the far left end that is fixed to the wall
